evidence: Independent pinned-image and retained actual-application COFF reads establish identical two-byte 8B FF gaps for stoi628950 at recorded body end6289FE and HSV_to_RGB628B70 at recorded body end628D92. Their explicit following target tables begin at DWORD-aligned628A00 and628D94. Existing function identities/spans and every original byte remain unchanged.

In the already authorized narrow i386 associated-data verifier, permit exactly the two-byte MOV EDI,EDI self-move as alignment only at an independently decoded terminating body end congruent2 modulo4, immediately before an explicitly declared DWORD-aligned switch-target table. Require the original and candidate gaps to be byte-identical8BFF with no relocations and compare both bytes normally. This does not permit arbitrary instructions, wider gaps, backward searches for returns, implicit data, truncation, or ignoring bytes. Add wrong-gap, alignment and extent damage controls.

The independent review correctly distinguishes an operand reference from proof of complete dispatch extent. Require a recognized original unsigned compare/out-of-range-branch guarded dispatch, unchanged index and compare EFLAGS along its bounded straight-line path, and table length equal to the complete guard-derived domain. A selector variant may use one declared indexed MOVZX byte map or an explicitly proven XOR-zeroed register followed by its low-byte MOV load, with map length equal to the guard-derived domain, every map value in the target-table range, and complete target domain accounted. Intervening floating-point instructions are supported only with independently established non-modification of the compared general register and integer EFLAGS. Reject unsupported dataflow/control flow, alternate entries or register-alias writes rather than inferring bounds from candidate section size. Source/table metadata alone never grants this physical proof. Preserve all previous acceptance and publication prerequisites.
